primary: Market SHORT at the actually observed decision quote, original absolute SL/TP and original TP weights/BE; no target reanchoring
decision_time: actual event, not inferred from creation/invalid.at; quote timestamp and age mandatory
R: geometric abs(actual CF fill-initial actual protectiveSL), fees separate; source risk+cost denominator not mixed
geometry: SHORT requires initial SL > CFfill > TP1 > TP2 > TP3 >0; already-passed targets=>INEXECUTABLE_GEOMETRY, not instant profits
execution: actual quote/lot filters; no profitable fillbar TP; SLfirst ambiguous 1m, worse gap open; no fake touch fill
BE: exact original rule and verified deployed fee offset only after actual modeled TP1 execution; not assume BE=entry
BTC_regime: known closed BTC r24 atdecision <=-3% falling, >=+3% rising, otherwise sideways
peak: latest timestamp of max high in preceding168 closed1h atsignal; no future peak
comparators: existing actual policy, fixed original-geometry CF; existing PF_MARKET/PF_CHASE/resting diagnostics only after recipe identity and new preregistration, not repeated old grid
samples: all emitted and dropped signals, distinct signalIDs; nofill/pending/gaps retained; UTC coverage explicit
validation: no parameter optimization; calendarH1/H2 of complete event coverage, last40 exposed overlap explicit; paired controls/concentration/week-coin dependence; no significance claim before valid prespecified inference
minimum_screen: 40 independent closed missed events per key group only preliminary minimum, not a powered proof; n requirement for inference unknown until variance/effect plan; no recommendation from tiny subgroups
stop_gate: missing decision prices/times/deployed plan/event ledger=>do not run; no notebook access or new downloads
